title: The foundation for AI-native teams
body: Everything you need to ship — the building blocks, the integrations, and the guardrails. Pick one to explore how it fits.

database.label: Database visualization
database.body: Live charts for every cluster, with drill-through to the individual query.

auth.label: Advanced authentication
auth.body: OAuth, SAML, passkeys — the whole catalog, turned on with a single flag.

identity.label: Identity management
identity.body: User + org + role in one place. Provisioning via SCIM, audit log included.

analytics.label: Analytics dashboard
analytics.body: Event streams, cohort retention, and funnel analysis without a second tool.
